pages.text: The mod has its own tab of $(thing)advancements$() (press $(k:key.advancements)): 26 of them, starting with your first drive. Its branches: road trips, fuel, owning cars, the law, looking after a car (from a wash to a dent, a repair, a tuning kit and a race), trailers, and the driving jobs.
Five cars to your name: a goal reached.

The hardest:$(li)$(l)Cross Country$(): 10,000 blocks without getting out, worth 100 experience$(li)$(l)Fleet Owner$(): five cars of your own at once$(li)$(l)Checkered Flag$(): win a race$(li)$(l)Road Crew$(): 100 blocks of road with a Road Paver in one go
The Reiko's Cars tab, with your first drive at its root.
